us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Texas court cuts Alex Jones’ $50 million Sandy Hook judgment to about $6 million
bullets: A Texas appeals court reduced most of the punitive damages in the Sandy Hook defamation case.
The ruling left Jones liable for about $6 million in the Texas case.
A separate $1.25 billion Connecticut judgment against Jones remains unaffected.

articles.title: Chief Justice Roberts allows Trump’s White House ballroom work to continue for now
bullets: Chief Justice John Roberts issued a temporary order allowing construction to proceed.
The case involves President Trump’s $400 million White House ballroom project.
The Supreme Court is still considering the administration’s emergency request.

articles.title: Pentagon dismisses Stars and Stripes leaders after editorial-independence dispute
bullets: The Pentagon fired the military newspaper’s editor-in-chief and a top reporter for insubordination.
The dismissals followed public objections to Defense Department interference.
The outlet has a long history of editorial independence while partly Pentagon-funded.

articles.title: Justice Department inquiry seeks interviews tied to 2022 Mar-a-Lago search
bullets: Investigators sought voluntary interviews with officials connected to the FBI search.
The inquiry is examining whether there was a conspiracy against President Trump.
The 2022 search recovered classified documents from Trump’s Florida estate.

articles.title: Pentagon says military sexual-assault reporting rose while estimated incidents fell
bullets: A Pentagon report found more troops reported unwanted sexual contact to authorities.
Officials said overall prevalence still declined last year.
The Defense Department said higher reporting can help victims receive care and support accountability.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US and Iran trade threats ahead of new sanctions announcement
bullets: Washington and Tehran exchanged defiant messages before new U.S. sanctions planned for Monday.
The sanctions could affect Iran and major trading partners including China.
President Trump warned of consequences for countries giving Iran an economic lifeline.

articles.title: Somali pirates hijack oil tanker off Yemen in latest maritime attack
bullets: The Sibu 1 was hijacked off Yemen and allegedly linked to Iran’s shadow fleet.
AP reported it was the sixth commercial vessel seized by Somali pirates since April 21.
The incident adds to security concerns in a region already strained by war and sanctions.

articles.title: Gaza mediators say Israeli strikes threaten ceasefire efforts
bullets: Turkey, Egypt and Qatar condemned recent Israeli strikes in Gaza.
Mediators urged Israel to meet ceasefire obligations and avoid escalation.
The strikes came during a critical phase of efforts to end the conflict.

articles.title: Japan protests Russian missile tests near disputed islands
bullets: Japan criticized Russian navy missile tests around islands claimed by both countries.
Russia’s Pacific Fleet said Bastion missiles hit targets about 300 kilometers away.
The drills followed Vladimir Putin’s visit to the disputed island chain.

articles.title: Trump heads toward midterms with foreign-policy crises unresolved
bullets: Reuters reported Trump’s foreign-policy agenda is stalled before the midterms.
The Iran war, Ukraine and Gaza remain unresolved flashpoints.
Trump has renewed pressure tactics, including threats tied to Iran and Oman.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Jaishankar to visit Russia for trade and technology commission talks
bullets: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will visit Russia on August 23–24.
He will co-chair the 27th India-Russia intergovernmental commission session.
The agenda includes trade, economic, scientific, technological and cultural cooperation.

articles.title: Gujarat spurious-liquor tragedy death toll rises to nine
bullets: Officials said the Bhavnagar hooch tragedy death toll rose to nine on Saturday.
Three people remained in critical condition, according to the district administration.
Police have arrested 13 of 21 accused named in the FIR.

articles.title: Five killed as bus ploughs into crowd at Bihar cultural event
bullets: A bus hit a roadside crowd in West Champaran late Friday night.
Police said five men were killed and several people were injured.
The bus reportedly swerved while trying to avoid a head-on collision with a truck.

articles.title: Indian Express flags 22 Indians aboard ships hijacked near Yemen and Somalia
bullets: The Indian Express listed the hijackings among its August 22 top front-page stories.
The report said 22 Indians were aboard two ships hijacked near Yemen and Somalia.
The story comes amid a broader rise in piracy and maritime-security incidents in the region.

articles.title: India reports ₹4,895 crore in FDI projects under revised framework
bullets: A current-affairs digest citing The Hindu listed the figure as a top August 22 headline.
The projects were reported under India’s revised FDI framework.
The Ministry of Commerce and Industry said projects had been reported up to August 10.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Ross Stores rallies after strong earnings and higher guidance
bullets: Ross Stores shares jumped after the retailer raised its annual profit outlook.
The company reported stronger quarterly profit and revenue than analysts expected.
Brokerages including JPMorgan and Barclays raised price targets after the results.

articles.title: Robinhood jumps as bitcoin rally lifts crypto-linked stocks
bullets: Robinhood Markets rose 13.7% on Friday, according to AP’s market report.
Bitcoin climbed above $77,000 after trading below $63,000 a week earlier.
Crypto-linked equities were among the strongest groups on Wall Street.

articles.title: Coinbase gains as crypto stocks rally with bitcoin
bullets: Coinbase Global shares gained 8.2% during Friday’s session.
The move coincided with a sharp rally in bitcoin and broader crypto names.
BestStocks listed the jump as a major price move for COIN on August 21.

articles.title: Freeport-McMoRan rises on copper-market strength
bullets: Freeport-McMoRan rose 7.6% on August 21, according to market-mover tracking.
The move was tied to strength in copper markets and demand expectations.
AI data centers, electric vehicles and grid electrification were cited as demand drivers.

articles.title: OSI Systems falls after revenue miss and cautious guidance
bullets: OSI Systems shares dropped after weaker-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter revenue.
Management cited delayed security deliveries linked to Middle East conflict constraints.
The company also issued fiscal 2027 guidance that disappointed investors.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Top corporate and economy stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Walmart to add Apple Pay and other tap-to-pay options
bullets: Walmart said some U.S. stores and Sam’s Club locations will add tap-to-pay beginning Monday.
The move adds options such as Apple Pay after years of reliance on Walmart Pay.
Axios reported the change as a notable shift in Walmart checkout strategy.

articles.title: Trump plan expands tariff-free beef imports to lower prices
bullets: The administration will allow up to 300,000 metric tons of ground beef to enter tariff-free for 90 days.
The plan drew immediate pushback from cattle producers and rural-state Republicans.
Trump said the deal aimed to lower beef prices for consumers.

articles.title: Minnesota Timberwolves and Lynx sale values teams at $4.5 billion
bullets: Axios reported Marc Lore agreed to sell his control stake in the NBA and WNBA teams.
The deal values the Minnesota Timberwolves and Lynx at a $4.5 billion enterprise value.
The sale follows other major NBA ownership transactions this month.

articles.title: Walmart posts slowest US comparable-sales growth in six years
bullets: Walmart reported 2.6% U.S. comparable-sales growth for the latest quarter.
The result raised concerns about lower-income shoppers facing higher costs.
Shares fell sharply even as the retailer raised its full-year outlook.

articles.title: US and Canadian trade teams race to avoid new tariff deadline
bullets: Top U.S. and Canadian trade negotiators met for a third day in Washington.
Reuters reported the talks aimed to finalize a deal before new U.S. tariffs took effect.
Trump has threatened a 50% tariff on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Nvidia invests in Cloverleaf Infrastructure for AI data-center power projects
bullets: Nvidia made a minority investment in privately held Cloverleaf Infrastructure.
The companies said the deal will support AI data-center infrastructure across the U.S.
Financial terms were not disclosed.

articles.title: US senators press TikTok over experiment that withheld safety measures
bullets: Sens. Marsha Blackburn and Richard Blumenthal demanded answers from TikTok.
Their letter followed reporting that TikTok withheld an algorithmic safety measure from users.
The senators asked for a response by September 1.

articles.title: CrowdStrike CTO leaves to launch AI-cybersecurity venture fund
bullets: CrowdStrike global CTO Elia Zaitsev is leaving after more than 13 years.
He is launching Cognition, a venture firm focused on AI and cybersecurity.
Axios reported the fund is targeting $170 million.

articles.title: SK Hynix plans major buyback amid AI-chip volatility
bullets: Axios reported SK Hynix plans to return cash to shareholders through a buyback.
The move follows a two-month share slump for the memory-chip giant.
AI-related volatility has made SK Hynix and Samsung major drivers of South Korea’s KOSPI.

articles.title: Executives grow more cautious linking AI gains to layoffs
bullets: Axios reported CEOs are changing how they discuss AI efficiency and job cuts.
Companies still face investor pressure to show returns on AI spending.
The shift reflects rising economic concerns and employee sensitivity around automation.
